rows.grounds: hyphenated compound/adjective-noun phrase; neuter accusative singular limb
passive optative form indicating possible omission

items.question: What happens to a mantra if one of its limbs is omitted?
items.inference: Omitting one limb makes the mantra impure.
items.plain_english: If one limb is omitted, the mantra becomes impure.
